summary: Implements the first concrete filesystem-backed SessionRepository (src/pcae/interactive_workflow/persistence/filesystem_repository.py, FilesystemSessionRepository), the first production storage backend for the SessionRepository ABC (Phase 143K), exactly per IWPC-001 v1.1 Section 13 (IWPC-REQ-066 through IWPC-REQ-077), Section 19.1, Section 21, Section 22, and Section 23. Storage layout: a flat .pcae/decision-sessions/<session_id>.json directory, one file per session, session_id used verbatim as the filename stem. Atomicity: every create/persist routes through tempfile.mkstemp (same directory) -> write -> flush -> os.fsync -> os.replace, with a finally-block cleanup of any leftover temp file, mirroring cltr/persistence.py's _write_atomic and governance/publication/storage.py's _write_atomic_json (this repository's strongest existing durable-write precedent, per IWPC-REQ-072 itself). Wire format: a store-level schema_version ("decision-session-store/1.0") wraps Session's own serialized payload (produced by the existing interactive_workflow/serialization/schema.py to_payload/from_payload functions), resolving IWPC-REQ-074's schema_version-key collision via nesting rather than a flat merge (a documented judgment call). Corruption detection: a new SessionStoreCorruptError (named but left undefined by IWPC-REQ-075) is raised for malformed/truncated JSON, an unrecognized store schema_version, a missing/malformed nested session payload, or a mismatched top-level vs. nested session_id; no partial/best-effort recovery is ever attempted. Security: every session_id is validated via the existing session.identity.validate_session_id (CDS-<uuid4> regex) before any filesystem path is constructed; symlinked session files, and a symlinked storage root, are both refused. Concurrency: no locking primitive is present in the module; persist is last-write-wins at the filesystem layer, the disclosed, accepted v1.0 behavior per IWPC-REQ-073/141/147 -- not silently upgraded to compare-and-set. No CLI command, transport adapter, Pending-Readiness Store, publication orchestration, application service, governance-record publish, or engineering execution capability was implemented; no IWC-001/PEC-001/CHGR-001/IWPC-001 contract text was changed. See docs/PHASE_145D_SESSIONREPOSITORY_CONCRETE_FILESYSTEM_IMPLEMENTATION.md.
tests_added_or_updated: tests/test_phase_145d_session_repository_filesystem_implementation.py (43 new tests: interface conformance, repository operations, storage layout/wire format, atomicity, corruption detection, security -- path-traversal and symlink rejection, permissions --, concurrency, round-trip compatibility, and a dependency-boundary AST-based forbidden-import test). Existing Interactive Workflow (143K-143P series), Publication (144C/144D/144F/144G series), and forbidden-import boundary test suites were left unmodified.
